# Contributing

Thanks for helping improve Codex Usage Status.

## Development

1. Install Node.js 20 or newer.
2. Run `npm ci`.
3. Make a focused change.
4. Run `npm run check`.
5. Run `npm run package` when changing extension packaging or activation.

Add tests for behavior changes. Do not include authentication data, prompts,
responses, workspace content, or unreviewed Codex diagnostics in issues or
test fixtures.
